title: Seasonal Badges Only Progress Inside Their Season
summary: Seasonal badges are now measured inside their own event window. A spending spree in July or a career level reached in March no longer counts toward the Halloween and New Year badges, and an out-of-season badge shows no progress at all.

highlights.title: Nothing to Bank Off-Season
highlights.description: A badge that asks you to spend counts only the coins you spend once the event is open, and a milestone badge has to be crossed during the event, so a lifetime total can no longer collect a badge the moment its window opens.

highlights.title: Every Event Starts Fresh
highlights.description: Each window starts from your account as it was when the event opened, so last year's progress never carries into this year's badge.

items: Seasonal badges no longer count spending or levels earned outside their event window
An out-of-season seasonal badge reports no progress instead of the account's lifetime total
Per-event progress is stored against each window, so a new occurrence always starts from zero
